title: The pull requests opened, merged and closed over a window
description: What `prs summary --json` and `prs tui --view summary --json` print: the Summary tab's numbers for one window, then what they were counted from. Every count is split into all, those a person opened and those an app opened, and one whose author is gone counts as a person's. The merged and closed pull requests are GitHub's, read from a cache the run brings up to date. Every field is always present but owners. A measure over no pull request is null rather than 0.

registry.description: The registry the repos come from, and empty where prs reads owners whole.

owners.description: The owners read whole in a registry's place, with @me for the token's own account.

window.description: The window's start as it was given, such as 30d or 2026-10-01.

until.description: The instant the window ends before: now, or --until.

open.description: The pull requests open at until, on every host prs reads.

opened.description: The pull requests opened within the window, whether open or closed now.

merged.description: The pull requests merged within the window.

closed_unmerged.description: The pull requests closed within the window without merging.

median_seconds_to_merge.description: From opening to merging, over the merges within the window, joined straight between the two nearest ranks.

merged_reviewed_by_round.description: The merges within the window whose first review was a Claude review round's, of any grammar version, from an app or someone who can write to the repo.

merged_reviewed_by_round_share.description: merged_reviewed_by_round as a share of merged, from 0 to 1.

repos.description: Each repo with a merge within the window, the most merges first, then by name.

time_to_merge.description: The merges within the window by how long each took from opening, in buckets shortest first, each naming its own edges.

to_seconds.description: Null on the last bucket, which has no end.

merged_per.description: The span each of merged_over counts: an hour for a short window, else a day.

merged_over.description: The merges in each hour or day, from the one holding since to the one holding until. A day starts at local midnight, so the first and last are partly outside the window and count only what falls inside it.

open_over.description: The open pull requests at evenly spaced instants from since, a whole number of hours apart, then at until.

cache.description: Where the merged and closed pull requests are kept, and how far back they reach. Null where nothing has been read into it.

path.description: The SQLite file, and empty where the run had nowhere to keep it.

from.description: Every pull request merged or closed at or after this is kept.

synced.description: Each kept pull request is as it stood at this instant or later.

notes.description: What the counts leave out, a sentence each, such as a window reaching past what the cache holds, or a host whose closed pull requests are not read.

sources.description: How each read stands: each host's open listing, then GitHub's merged and closed.
